note: Golden wire vectors for the Partner Session Protocol v1. Host-side CI (this SDK) and pane-side CI (0xramp.app) must both pass this exact set before any release. All values are synthetic: no real addresses, amounts, tickets, or PII.

kinds.bridge.pane-to-host: Full envelope as sent by the pane; validate with paneToHostMessageSchema.
kinds.bridge.host-to-pane: Full envelope as sent by the host; validate with hostToPaneMessageSchema.
kinds.api.request: HTTP request body for the partner sessions endpoint; validate with createSessionRequestSchema.
kinds.api.response: HTTP response body from the partner sessions endpoints; validate with createSessionResponseSchema or sessionStatusResponseSchema.
kinds.return-url: Deep-link return vector; parse with parseReturnUrl and compare to `expected`.
